steps.code:
# Fetch all sent payment requests (paginate) to identify those from yesterday evening (May 19, 2023)
all_sent = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    # Assume resp is a list of requests
    if not resp:
        break
    all_sent.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

# Filter for requests created on May 19, 2023
yesterday_requests = [r for r in all_sent if r.get('created_at', '').startswith('2023-05-19')]
print("Requests created on May 19, 2023:")
for r in yesterday_requests:
    print(r)
